title: Simulation cell setup and equilibration
action: Construct Si-free (Fe24O36) and Si-doped (Fe18O27Si6O12) nanoparticle models in 19 LiPF6 electrolyte in a cubic cell of side 18.26 Å, and perform initial thermalization using DFT-based molecular dynamics for 1.33 ps at 500 K.
description: Equilibrated initial atomic configurations for both systems are required for subsequent lithiation/delithiation simulations.

title: Lithiation simulation
action: Inject 18 extra electrons into the simulation cell and run DFT-MD for 4.84 ps at 500 K for both Si-free and Si-doped systems.
description: Trajectories of lithiated nanoparticles; these are inputs for subsequent delithiation and structural analyses.

title: Delithiation simulation
action: Remove 18 electrons from the lithiated cells and run DFT-MD for 1.82 ps at 500 K for both systems.
description: Trajectories of delithiating nanoparticles; these are the primary source for all structural stability analyses.

title: Kinetic energy of dissociated Li atoms
action: From the delithiation trajectories, identify Li atoms that dissociate from the nanoparticle by the end of the simulation, then compute their average kinetic energy as a function of time. Output the time series for both Si-free and Si-doped systems.
description: Time evolution of the average kinetic energy of Li atoms that become dissociated. The Si-doped system should show a gentler rise compared to the Si-free system.
output_schema: CSV with columns: time_ps (float), avg_ke_si_free_eV (float), avg_ke_si_doped_eV (float). At least 10 time points from 0 to 1.82 ps.

title: Geometric deformation (minimized RMSD)
action: For each delithiation trajectory, compute the translationally and rotationally minimized root-mean-square displacement D for all nanoparticle atoms, using the initial delithiation configuration as reference. Output the time series for both systems.
description: D quantifies the geometric distortion of the nanoparticle during delithiation. Si-doped system should show lower D values.
output_schema: CSV with columns: time_ps (float), D_si_free_angstrom (float), D_si_doped_angstrom (float). Same time points as kinetic_energy.csv.

title: Bond-topology change (Hamming distance)
action: Compute the Hamming distance DH between bond adjacency matrices at the initial delithiation time and each subsequent time for both systems. Output the time series.
description: DH counts bond-breakage and bond-formation events. Si-doped system should have about 30% lower DH than Si-free.
output_schema: CSV with columns: time_ps (float), DH_si_free (float), DH_si_doped (float). Same time points.

title: Bond overlap population before electron removal
action: Perform Mulliken bond overlap population analysis on the final lithiated snapshot (just before electron removal) for Li-O bonds. Output a histogram of BOP values for both systems.
description: BOP distribution quantifies the covalency of Li-O bonds in the lithiated state. Si-free should show a sharp peak at positive bond orders (strong bonding), while Si-doped should lack that peak.
output_schema: CSV with columns: bop_value (float), frequency_si_free (float), frequency_si_doped (float). Histogram bins across the BOP range.

title: Bond overlap population immediately after electron removal
action: Perform the same BOP analysis on the snapshot immediately after removing electrons (early delithiation). Output the histogram.
description: BOP distribution after electron removal shows the change in bonding. Si-free should show a negative (anti-bonding) peak, while Si-doped should not.
output_schema: CSV with columns: bop_value (float), frequency_si_free (float), frequency_si_doped (float). Histogram bins.
